title: Regularity for axisymmetric Navier-Stokes with an Euler length
summary: We prove local regularity for axisymmetric suitable weak solutions of the 3D Navier-Stokes equations, which are smooth before the terminal time $t=0$, and satisfy Type~II pointwise bounds at a vanishing length scale $\ell(t)$. We say $\ell(t)$ is an Euler length if it is non-increasing, satisfies a doubling condition, and if $\ell(t)\to0$ and $(-t)/\ell(t)^2\to0$ as $t\to0^-$. This includes power laws $\ell(t)=(-t)^γ$ with $0<γ<1/2$, and logarithmic enlargements of the parabolic length.
